_instructions: The full merchant application on /sign-up. Fields, order, wording and required rules mirror the application form in the EPAY CRM (app/index.html > APPLICATION_LINK_SECTIONS) so a submission from the website and one from a CRM link are the same record. Change a label here and the page follows; the CRM copy must be changed to match.
_note_on_where_it_goes: The form posts straight to the CRM (Supabase RPC public_submit_application) over HTTPS. It does NOT go through Netlify Forms — this page collects a social security number, date of birth, driver's licence and bank account, and Netlify Forms stores submissions in plain text in a dashboard. The CRM encrypts those five fields on arrival and never writes them to its plain-text audit record.
_note_on_keys: crm.anon_key is Supabase's publishable anon key. It is designed to sit in public web pages; it grants nothing on its own, and the only thing this page can call is the insert-only application function.

crm._note_on_slug: Set 2026-09-28. Resolves against application_link_tokens.slug in the CRM — NOT partners.link_slug, which belongs to the /r/<slug> referral pages and a different RPC (public_submit_referral_lead). The token carries the brand, an optional partner to credit and a label that becomes the lead's source line, and counts its own submissions.
crm._note_on_lead_slug: Set 2026-09-28. Enquiries arrive at the Inbound Lead stage with lead_source "Lead form — EPAY POS Website". Partner-tagged traffic uses the partner's own token instead — see content/partners.json.

alert._note: Every submitted application also sends an alert to the sales inbox through Netlify Forms, so the team is told by email as well as in the CRM. This keeps working after the CRM link is connected.
alert._note_on_what_is_sent: Business and contact details, volumes and the chosen plan. It deliberately does NOT carry the social security number, date of birth, driver's licence, tax ID or bank account: email and the Netlify dashboard both store text in the clear, and those five belong only in the CRM, encrypted. The alert links the team to the CRM for the rest.
alert._note_on_recipient: Netlify decides who gets it: Netlify dashboard > Forms > application-alert > Form notifications > add an email notification to sales@epaypos.net. The recipient is not set in this file, the same as the site's other forms.

_note_on_param_count: public_submit_application takes 28 parameters. Sending 27 fails with PGRST202 (function not found) — PostgREST resolves overloads by exact argument set, so a missing parameter reads as a missing function, not a missing value. If a field is added or removed here, the CRM function signature has to change in the same breath.
